notes: Old Japanese cards (the 1996-2001 Pocket Monsters back) are recognised: their back colour and print dots are no longer compared with English cards, and one cut a little small all round shows as a check, not as possible trimming or a fake
Fewer false trimming warnings: grey-bordered cards on a grey lid, and dark-bordered cards on black in scans that don't carry their resolution
A small chip on a card back scanned on the black lid is no longer missed as scanner glare
The fake checks hold up better when a scanner's colour or brightness is a little off
